rootCauseOneLine: plugins/provider-acp/src/interactions.ts buildAcpPermissionInteractionPayload always emits a `command` approval subject with command = rawInput.command ?? title ?? kind, ignoring the ACP toolCall.kind ("edit") and locations, so a file-write permission (no rawInput.command, title = file/dir path) renders as "run this command $ /path" and the server materialises it as a commandExecution timeline item under the same toolCallId that event-translation already/next emits as fileChange.
proposedFix: In plugins/provider-acp: forward toolCall.locations[].path from handlePermissionRequest (bridge.ts) into AcpPermissionToolCall, and in buildAcpPermissionInteractionPayload (interactions.ts) return a `file_change` subject {itemId: toolCallId, writeScope: first location ?? null, sessionGrant: null} when toolCall.kind is edit/delete/move and no rawInput.command is present; keep the command fallback otherwise. No server/protocol change (file_change is already a legal subject; wire shape unchanged, so no HOST_DAEMON_PROTOCOL_VERSION bump). Patch at /tmp/bb-reports/issues/1719/repro/proposed-fix.patch; verified: repro test passes, existing interactions/bridge tests (75) pass, typecheck passes, app shows "Do you want to make these changes?" and timeline stays fileChange. Open choice: writeScope as file path vs dirname vs null (UI labels it "Write root").
caveats: opencode is not installed on this machine, so the live repro uses bb's fake ACP agent extended to emit exactly what opencode's ACP layer sends for a write permission (kind "edit", title = path, locations, rawInput without command), registered via customAcpAgents; the opencode-side shapes were verified from anomalyco/opencode source (acp/permission.ts, acp/tool.ts). Whether the reporter's "bare directory" came from opencode's write permission (title = file path) or external_directory permission (title = parentDir) is unverified; both hit the same code path. The worktree was left with the proposed fix applied plus the repro test (uncommitted); worktree HEAD is detached at 16ceb3a54 (it started at a108fa7ef). Not fixed on origin/main as of a108fa7ef.
